This is a guide, not legal advice. SACCO: Kino kya kulagirira, si magezi ga mateeka. SACCO Ledger terina layisinsi yonna ku lulwo, era okukozesa app eno si layisinsi. Saba munnamateeka wa Uganda akakase ebikukwatako nga tonnatandika. Ebisale n'amateeka bikyuka: buuza buli kitongole ekirondoola.
